catalogClauses.base:
Gathers the hero's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and purges enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only purge debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
catalogClauses.super: Super: Applies Purifying Flames to all enemies and allies within the effect radius of the main target, dealing 360 magical damage. This applies before the dispel. Heals 44 health per second over 9 seconds.
catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: Applies Rain of Destiny, centered on the main target. Heals/Damages allies/enemies for 60 health per second over 10 seconds. While inside Rain of Destiny, allies/enemies have their heal amplification increased/reduced by 25%.
